verdict.rationale: LegalOS is an AI-assisted immigration platform that collects sensitive employer and candidate data through intake flows, so control over data retention and deletion is a fair axis for it. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of retention policies, deletion requests, or user-facing data controls. The cited pages cover only visa services, fees, attorney review and disclaimers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
